annotation.bound_parties_text: The text says Part 21 sets requirements for the certification, registration, operations and surveillance of Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems (RPAS), so it binds RPAS operators and pilots; the text does not name them explicitly.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Part 21 sets forth the requirements for the certification, registration, operations, and surveillance of Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems (RPAS).
